IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r5.claim: One version has the Prophet say that even if given the earth's gold and wealth, he would not accept anything other than that word; another compares the offer to the sun in his right hand and moon in his left.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r5.anchor: وفي رواية: لو جعلتم الشمس في يميني والقمر في شمالي ما أرضاني منكم غيرها، فقاموا عند ذلك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r6.claim: The author presents the full sense of the account while noting that its versions vary in additions and omissions but agree in their general point.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r6.anchor: وجلبت هذا الخبر تام المعنى، وفي بعض رواياته زيادة ونقصان، والغرض متقارب

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وأبو طالب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r7.claim: The Prophet urged Abu Talib to say the profession of faith so he could testify for him before God; Abu Talib said fear of blame among his descendants prevented him, and he died following Abd al-Muttalib's religion.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r7.anchor: قل لا إله إلا الله كلمة أشهد لك بها عند الله، فقال: والله لولا أن تكون سبة في بني بعدي

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r8.claim: The account is linked to the revelation of 28:56.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493/r8.anchor: ومات وهو يقول: على ملة عبد المطلب، فنزلت في ذلك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r1.claim: The phrase وانطلق is connected to the account of Abu Talib and the verse 28:56.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r1.anchor: إنك لا تهدي من أحببت [القصص: 56] وانطلق

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r2.speaker: جماعة من المفسرين
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r2.claim: A group of exegetes says وانطلق describes the leaders leaving Abu Talib's gathering.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r2.anchor: هذا قول جماعة من المفسرين. وقالت فرقة: هي عبارة عن إذاعتهم لهذه الأقاويل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r3.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r3.claim: Another group says وانطلق refers to their spreading these statements, as in common speech about people setting off with a public prayer or appeal.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r3.anchor: وقالت فرقة: هي عبارة عن إذاعتهم لهذه الأقاويل، فكأنه كما يقول الناس: انطلق الناس بالدعاء للأمير

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r4.claim: الملأ are the notables and leaders who stand in for the rest in matters of opinion.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r4.anchor: والملأ الأشراف والرؤوس الذين يسدون مسد الجميع في الآراء ونحوه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r5.claim: أن is explanatory and has no syntactic position; alternatively, it is an accusative verbal noun after an omitted preposition, بأن.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r5.anchor: وقوله: أن امشوا أن مفسرة لا موضع لها في الإعراب، ويجوز أن يكون في موضع نصب بإسقاط حرف الجر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r6.claim: Their meaning is for one another to proceed and persist in every matter concerning their gods.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r6.anchor: ومعنى الآية أنه قال بعضهم لبعض امشوا واصبروا على كل أمر آلهتكم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r7.speaker: بعض الناس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r7.claim: Some take امشوا as a call to acquire livestock, but the author rejects this as grammatically weak and unsuitable to the context.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r7.anchor: وذهب بعض الناس إلى أن قولهم: امشوا، هو دعاء بكسب الماشية، وفي هذا ضعف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r8.claim: The author prefers the sense continue on your path; alternatively, they may have said it as an order to move their feet as they left.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r8.anchor: وإنما المعنى: سيروا على طريقتكم ودوموا على سيركم، أو يكون المعنى: أمر من نقل الأقدام

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r9.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r9.claim: The codex of Abdullah ibn Masud reads وانطلق الملأ منهم يمشون أن اصبروا.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r9.anchor: وهو في مصحف عبد الله بن مسعود: «وانطلق الملأ منهم يمشون أن اصبروا»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r10.claim: They mean that Muhammad's rise and eminence through prophethood is intended for them, so they must submit to him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p493#2/r10.anchor: وقولهم: إن هذا لشيء يراد يريدون ظهور محمد وعلوه بالنبوة، أي يراد منا: الانقياد إليه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r1.speaker: المفسرون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r1.claim: Exegetes say Quraysh's notables gathered at Abu Talib's, complained about the Prophet, recoiled from his call to worship one God, and left Abu Talib's house.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r1.anchor: لما اجتمع أشراف قريش عند أبي طالب وشكوا إليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على ما سبق بياه نفروا من قوله لا إله إلا الله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r2.claim: Inṭalaqū means they went away readily; the related expression ṭalāqat al-wajh describes a cheerful, open face.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r2.anchor: الانطلاق الذهاب بسهولة ومنه طلاقة الوجه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r3.claim: The malāʾ are Quraysh's leading men.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r3.anchor: والملأ أشراف قريش فخرجوا يقول بعضهم لبعض

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r4.claim: The particle an is explanatory, meaning that they said, go or leave.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r5.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r5.claim: Al-Zajjaj also parses it as going forth with the words, go and remain steadfast.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r5.anchor: قال الزجاج ويجوز أن يكون المعنى انطلقوا بأن امشوا أي انطلقوا بهذا القول

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r6.speaker: بعضهم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r6.claim: Some say the notables left to urge one another to go to Abu Talib and complain about his nephew.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r6.anchor: وقال بعضهم المعنى انطلقوا يقولون امشوا إلى أبي طالب فاشكوا إليه ابن أخيه

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r7.claim: They tell each other to remain steadfast in worship of their gods.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r7.anchor: ﴿ واصبروا على آلهتكم ﴾ أي اثبتوا على عبادتها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r8.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r8.claim: This refers to the growth in Muhammad's followers, which they view as an affair intended against them.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p103/r8.anchor: ﴿ لشيء يراد ﴾ أي لأمر يراد بنا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r3.claim: The al-malaʾ are the people's chiefs, leaders, heads, and grandees.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r4.claim: Their leaders urge people to persist in their religion and remain patient in devotion to their gods rather than accept Muhammad's call to monotheism.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53/r4.anchor: أي: استمروا على دينكم {واصبروا على آلهتكم} ولا تستجيبوا لما يدعوكم إليه محمد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r1.speaker: ابن جرير
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r1.claim: Ibn Jarir says they suspect Muhammad seeks status, dominance over them, and followers through his call to monotheism, so they refuse to follow him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن جرير: إن هذا الذي يدعونا (3) إليه محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم من التوحيد لشيء يريد به الشرف عليكم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r2.speaker: السدي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r2.claim: Al-Suddi reports that Quraysh chiefs asked Abu Talib to stop Muhammad denouncing idols, fearing Arab reproach if they harmed him after Abu Talib died; Muhammad invited them to the one-word testimony, refused alternatives, then Abu Talib declined and 28:56 was revealed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p53#2/r2.anchor: قال السدي: إن أناسا من قريش اجتمعوا فيهم: أبو جهل بن هشام والعاص بن وائل

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r4.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r4.claim: Intilaq means departing easily, related to an open face.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r4.anchor: والانطلاق الذهاب بسهولة ومنه طلاقة الوجه

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r5.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r5.claim: Mujahid identifies a leader as Uqba ibn Muayt.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r5.anchor: أنه عقبة بن معيط , قاله مجاهد

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies him as Abu Jahl, who complained about the Prophet to ill Abu Talib and left despairing of restraining him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r6.anchor: حين يئس من كفه ، قاله ابن عباس

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r7.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r7.claim: One reading is to leave Muhammad and worship their gods.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r8.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r8.claim: Alternatively, persist in resistance and worship; Arabs say walking on a matter means adhering to it.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r8.anchor: الثاني : امضوا على أمركم في المعاندة واصبروا على آلهتكم في العبادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r9.speaker: مقاتل
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r9.claim: Muqatil links the remark to Umar's conversion, strengthening Islam and upsetting Quraysh.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r9.anchor: أن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه لما أسلم وقوي به الإسلام شق على قريش فقالوا إن الإسلام عمر فيه قوة للإسلام وشيء يراد , قاله مقاتل

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r10.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r10.claim: They may accuse Muhammad of seeking leadership by opposing their religion.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p78/r10.anchor: أن خلاف محمد لنا ومفارقته لديننا إنما يريد به الرياسة علينا والتملك لنا

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r2.claim: The chiefs were twenty-seven nobles, including al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, Abū Jahl, Umayya, and Ubayy ibn Khalaf.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r2.anchor: وهم سبعة وعشرون رجلا، والملأ فى كلام العرب الأشراف منهم الوليد بن المغيرة، وأبو جهل بن هشام

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r3.speaker: الوليد بن المغيرة
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r3.claim: Al-Walīd told them to go to Abū Ṭālib and remain firm in worship of their gods; the passage compares this firmness with 25:42 and God's answer in 41:24.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r3.anchor: فقال الوليد بن المغيرة: { أن امشوا } إلى أبى طالب { واصبروا } واثبتوا { على } عبادة { آلهتكم }

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r4.claim: The chiefs approached Abū Ṭālib, calling him their elder and leader, and asked him to arbitrate between them and his nephew.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r4.anchor: فشموا إلى أبى طالب، فقالوا: أنت شيخنا وكبيرنا وسيدنا فى أنفسنا وقد رأيت ما فعلت السفهاء

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r5.speaker: أبو طالب
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r5.claim: Abū Ṭālib summoned the Prophet and asked him to grant his people a fair settlement instead of leaning wholly against them.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r5.anchor: فقال أبو طالب: هؤلاء قومك، يسألونك السواء فلا تمل كل الميل على قومك

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r6.speaker: قريش
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r6.claim: Quraysh asked Muhammad to stop mentioning their gods, promising to leave him and his God alone.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r6.anchor: قالوا: ارفض ذكر آلهتنا وندعك وإلهك

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r7.claim: Muhammad offered them a single word that would make Arabs obey them and non-Arabs submit; Abū Jahl agreed to give that and ten more.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r7.anchor: تملكون بها العرب، وتدن لكم بها العجم

MUQATIL:38:5-6/r8.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r8.claim: Muhammad asked them to say there is no god but God; they recoiled, left, and complained that he would make their many gods one.
MUQATIL:38:5-6/r8.anchor: فقالوا: أجعل، يعنى وصف محمد الآلهة إلها واحدا أن تكون الآلهة واحدا

NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r1.claim: After the Prophet's decisive answer silenced them at Abū Ṭālib's gathering, Quraysh's leaders left and spoke among themselves.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r1.anchor: وانطلق أشراف قريش عن مجلس أبي طالب بعد ما بكتهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالجواب العتيد

NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r2.claim: أن means أي, since people leaving a disputation are expected to discuss what happened; their departure implies speech.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r2.anchor: وأن بمعنى أى لأن المنطلقين عن مجلس التقاول لابد لهم من أن يتكلموا ويتفاوضوا فيما جرى لهم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r3.claim: Their instruction is to persist in worshipping their idols.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r4.claim: One explanation is that God wills and decrees this affair, so it cannot be repelled and patience is their only recourse.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r4.anchor: أى يريده الله تعالى ويحكم بامضائه فلا مرد له ولا ينفع فيه إلا الصبر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r5.claim: Alternatively, they mean a calamity of time is destined for them and cannot be escaped.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p33/r5.anchor: أو أن هذا الأمر لشىء من نوائب الدهر يراد بنا فلا انفكاك لنا منه

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r1.claim: Al-malaʾ means the notables, and inṭilāq is going away quickly; the unbelievers left the Prophet urging one another to continue as before.

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r2.claim: Their instruction is to keep to their former way, avoid Muhammad’s religion, and persevere in worshipping their gods.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r2.anchor: أي امضوا على ما كنتم عليه ولا تدخلوا في دينه

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r3.claim: An alternate account takes their departure as their visit to Abu Talib during his illness, described earlier.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r3.anchor: وقيل هو إشارة إلى مشيهم إلى أبي طالب في مرضه كما سبق

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r4.speaker: محمد بن إسحاق
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r4.claim: Ibn Ishaq names the visitors to Abu Talib as Abu Jahl, Shayba and ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa, Umayya ibn Khalaf, al-ʿAs ibn Waʾil, and Abu Muʿayt; they demanded he stop his nephew and his followers.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r4.anchor: وفي رواية محمد بن إسحاق أنهم أبو جهل بن هشام، وشيبة وعتبة أبناء ربيعة بن عبد شمس،

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r5.claim: An is accusative here with an implied bi: they departed by saying, Go on.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r5.anchor: { أن امشوا } في موضع نصب والمعنى بأن امشوا.

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r6.claim: Alternatively, an means ay; the phrase explains what their departure amounted to, rather than quoting words they literally spoke.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r6.anchor: وقيل: «أن» بمعنى أي أي «وانطلق الملأ منهم» أي امشوا

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r7.claim: Another account has the nobles telling the common people to go on and remain steadfast in worship of their gods.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r7.anchor: وقيل: المعنى انطلق الأشراف منهم فقالوا للعوام: «امشوا واصبروا على آلهتكم»

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r8.claim: One explanation is that something is intended for the people of the earth: their people’s blessings will be removed and calamity will befall them.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r8.anchor: أي يراد بأهل الأرض من زوال نعم قوم وغير تنزل بهم

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r9.claim: Alternatively, they warn that Muhammad wants submission so he can dominate and control them, and urge people not to obey him.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r9.anchor: كلمة تحذير أي إنما يريد محمد بما يقول الانقياد له ليعلو علينا

QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r10.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r10.claim: Muqatil says Quraysh called Umar’s conversion a thing intended because it strengthened Islam and distressed them.
QURTUBI-FULL:38:6-8/r10.anchor: وقال مقاتل: إن عمر لما أسلم وقوي به الإسلام شق ذلك على قريش
